messages:
support: FYI — multiple customers reporting increased 502/504 and timeouts hitting hosted inference (us-west-2). First reports ~30m ago. Customer sample IDs: req=acme-7f3a, req=beta-22b0. Seeing p95 latency jumps and more 504s than usual. Raising for triage.

alex: looking. any correlation with deploys or scaling events?

support: no deploys in last 2h. We saw a config change to gateway keepalive at ~4999991200 from operations. No obvious billing/auth errors in logs — mostly upstream resets.

maria: I’m on the runtime side. I can pull service traces and batcher metrics. On it.

jordan: repro steps from a customer: send long streaming completion with max_tokens=4096 and client keepalive 60s -> request stalls, then 504. Attached sample curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d @long_prompt.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`

emily: timeline from metrics: at 4999991188 we saw a KV cache stall alert, at 4999991220 p95 tokens/time spikes, at 4999991240 error rate crossed 3% on hosted-gateway.

alex: ok, priority mitigation: 1) remove the keepalive tweak from gateway config (rollback) 2) temporarily increase gateway worker pool in us-west-2 3) enable stricter upstream timeouts to fail-fast. Who can rollback?

maria: I can rollback the keepalive change now. Doing `opsctl config rollback host-gateway us-west-2 --change=keepalive-2026-03-17`

maria: rollback started at 4999991250.

incidents-bot: Deploy rollback detected: host-gateway/us-west-2 @4999991252 by maria.

emily: after rollback we see error rate starting to decrease — p95 back down a bit. Still seeing some residual 502s from queued long requests.

jordan: customers reporting degraded but improved UX. One customer provided a trace: `upstream reset by peer` and `context deadline exceeded` about ~35s into stream.

alex: for immediate customer impact, enable request-level circuit-breaker for long-running streams (cut at 30s) and add more detailed request id logging. I'll submit the patch to enable short-circuit and roll to us-west-2 only.

maria: patch submitted and canary started 4999991270: `gateway: cb_timeout=30s canary=us-west-2`

incidents-bot: Canary rollout successful @4999991276.

emily: metrics post-canary: error rate down to baseline ~0.4% and p95 latency normalized. Customers contacting support are acknowledging fewer failures.

support: closing immediate customer escalations — communicated rollback + expected timeline for full recovery.

alex: root cause hypothesis: recent gateway keepalive change increased long-lived connection retention which caused resource exhaustion under heavy streaming workloads -> queueing -> upstream resets/timeouts. KV cache stall amplified latency.

maria: agree. We'll need to add protective limits on long streaming requests and better monitoring for connection churn.

jordan: action items for postmortem and customer followup:
- alex: add temporary canary policy to auto-fallback and an alert when long request backlog > 100 (due EOD).
- maria: instrument connection/keepalive histograms + add automated rollback test to CI (due 48h).
- emily: add dashboard with streaming request duration heatmap + KV cache saturation panel (due 24h).
- jordan: compile customer impact list and draft customer comms (due 12h).

alex: I'll open the incident ticket and schedule a 30m postmortem review at 4999994800 (approx tomorrow). Assigning owners to items above.

support: thanks all — customers updated. Marking this thread resolved for on-call; follow-ups tracked in the incident ticket.

incidents-bot: Incident resolved — summary: rollback of gateway keepalive + circuit-breaker canary mitigated 5xx/timeouts. Follow-up items assigned.
